description: This file defines the SmsHandler class responsible for managing SMS-related operations such as sending and searching SMS messages within an Android application. It interacts with an SmsManager instance and returns results encapsulated in GatewaySession.InvokeResult objects.

classes.name: SmsHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for handling SMS sending and searching functionalities with error handling.

methods.name: handleSmsSend
methods.description: Asynchronously sends an SMS message using provided JSON parameters and returns the result encapsulated in GatewaySession.InvokeResult.

methods.name: handleSmsSearch
methods.description: Asynchronously searches SMS messages based on provided JSON parameters and returns the result encapsulated in GatewaySession.InvokeResult.

methods.name: errorResult
methods.description: Constructs an error result with a specific error message and code, used when SMS operations fail.
